vision: AI-powered LinkedIn banner designer that creates stunning professional banners in seconds using multi-LLM orchestration and voice-powered workflows

target_audience.primary: Career-focused professionals in the Careersy Community who need professional LinkedIn banners to enhance their personal brand
secondary: Content creators needing social media banners for multiple platforms
Small business owners wanting professional branding materials
Job seekers looking to stand out with polished LinkedIn profiles
Marketing professionals managing client social media presence

phases.name: Foundation & Polish
phases.description: Stabilize the platform, fix technical debt, and enhance core AI generation capabilities to solidify competitive advantages

milestones.title: TypeScript Cleanup Complete
milestones.description: All 47+ 'any' types resolved with proper interfaces, improving code quality and maintainability

milestones.title: Test Suite Restored
milestones.description: CI tests re-enabled with comprehensive coverage, ensuring reliable deployments

milestones.title: Quick Start Templates Live
milestones.description: Users can generate professional banners from templates in under 30 seconds

phases.name: User Experience Excellence
phases.description: Streamline onboarding, enhance usability, and address competitor pain points around UI complexity and performance

milestones.title: Zero-to-Banner in 60 Seconds
milestones.description: New users can create and export their first banner within 60 seconds of signing up

milestones.title: Performance Optimized
milestones.description: App loads in under 2 seconds, canvas operations feel instant, no lag during generation

milestones.title: Mobile-Ready Design Experience
milestones.description: Full banner creation capability on mobile devices with touch-optimized controls

phases.name: Social & Publishing Integration
phases.description: Enable direct publishing workflows and team collaboration features that competitors lack

milestones.title: One-Click LinkedIn Publishing
milestones.description: Users can publish banners directly to LinkedIn without leaving the app

milestones.title: Team Collaboration Live
milestones.description: Teams can share brand profiles and collaborate on designs

phases.name: Intelligent Automation
phases.description: Deploy the Partner Agent system and advanced analytics for autonomous AI assistance

milestones.title: Partner Agent System Operational
milestones.description: AI agents autonomously assist users with banner creation and optimization

milestones.title: Analytics Dashboard Deployed
milestones.description: Users can track design performance and engagement metrics

phases.name: Future Vision
phases.description: Advanced features for power users, including motion graphics, real-time collaboration, and enterprise capabilities

milestones.title: Animated Banners Available
milestones.description: Users can create animated/motion banners for LinkedIn covers and video backgrounds

milestones.title: Real-Time Collaboration Live
milestones.description: Multiple users can edit the same design simultaneously with live cursors

features.title: TypeScript Type Safety Audit
features.description: Resolve all 47+ 'any' types identified in T007 audit with proper TypeScript interfaces. This improves code quality, enables better IDE support, and prevents runtime type errors.
features.rationale: Technical debt reduces development velocity and increases bug risk. Proper types enable faster feature development and easier onboarding for new contributors.
acceptance_criteria: All AI response types properly defined
Build passes with strict TypeScript checks
user_stories: As a developer, I want proper TypeScript types so that I can catch errors at compile time and have better IDE autocomplete

features.title: Restore Test Suite in CI
features.description: Re-enable the temporarily disabled tests in CI pipeline and achieve comprehensive test coverage for critical paths including AI generation, canvas operations, and authentication.
features.rationale: Tests were disabled to unblock deployment but this creates risk. Reliable CI prevents regressions and enables confident deployments.
acceptance_criteria: All existing tests passing in CI
E2E tests for critical user flows
user_stories: As a developer, I want reliable tests so that I can deploy with confidence without breaking existing functionality

features.title: Professional Template Library
features.description: Curated library of industry-specific LinkedIn banner templates (Tech, Finance, Healthcare, Creative, etc.) that users can customize with AI. Templates address common professional scenarios like job searching, thought leadership, and company promotion.
features.rationale: Users with limited design skills struggle to start from scratch. Templates provide instant professional starting points, directly addressing the pain point of 'lack of design skills'. This differentiates from Canva's generic templates by being LinkedIn-specific and career-focused.
acceptance_criteria: AI can customize any template element
Each template has preview and description
user_stories: As a job seeker, I want to select a professional template so that I can create a polished banner without design expertise
As a marketing professional, I want industry-specific templates so that my banner reflects my professional domain

features.title: Enhanced Brand Consistency Enforcement
features.description: Upgrade the brand consistency panel to automatically enforce brand guidelines during AI generation. When generating or editing images, AI should respect brand colors, fonts, and style preferences without manual intervention.
features.rationale: Users struggle to maintain brand consistency across designs. Canva requires manual checking; Nanobanna Pro can automatically enforce brand rules during AI generation, making it effortless.
acceptance_criteria: Brand colors automatically applied to AI generations
Font preferences respected in text overlays
Style guidelines (minimal, bold, etc.) influence generation
Warning shown when generation might violate brand rules
One-click brand compliance check for existing designs
user_stories: As a marketing professional, I want my brand guidelines automatically enforced so that all my banners look consistent without manual checking
As a content creator, I want AI to remember my brand style so that every generation matches my personal brand

features.title: Optimized Bundle Size & Code Splitting
features.description: Implement aggressive code splitting and lazy loading to reduce initial bundle size. Heavy features like canvas editor, AI services, and voice components should load on demand.
features.rationale: Competitors like Canva and Adobe Express suffer from performance issues with complex projects. Optimized loading creates a faster, more responsive experience that directly addresses user frustration with slow tools.
acceptance_criteria: Canvas editor loads on first navigation to /studio
Voice components load only when voice feature activated
user_stories: As a user on a slow connection, I want the app to load quickly so that I can start creating without waiting
As a mobile user, I want efficient loading so that I don't waste my data plan

features.title: Guided Onboarding Flow
features.description: Interactive onboarding that guides new users through creating their first banner in 60 seconds. Shows key features like AI generation, voice commands, and brand settings while the user creates a real output.
features.rationale: First impression is critical. Competitors have cluttered UIs that overwhelm users. A focused onboarding that produces a real result creates immediate value and demonstrates the AI-powered workflow.
acceptance_criteria: New users complete first banner within 60 seconds
Onboarding shows AI generation, templates, and export
Users can skip onboarding if desired
user_stories: As a new user, I want to be guided through creating my first banner so that I understand the tool's capabilities immediately
As someone unfamiliar with AI tools, I want a clear tutorial so that I feel confident using the features

features.title: Quick Generate Mode
features.description: Simplified one-click banner generation where users answer 3 questions (industry, style preference, key message) and AI generates 4 banner variants instantly. No canvas editing required for basic use cases.
features.rationale: Many users just want a professional banner quickly without learning a design tool. This addresses the time-consuming nature of traditional design while maintaining quality through AI.
acceptance_criteria: Users can select, refine, or regenerate variants
Direct export without canvas editing if satisfied
Option to 'Edit in Studio' for further customization
user_stories: As a busy professional, I want to generate a banner with minimal input so that I can update my LinkedIn in minutes
As someone who dislikes design tools, I want a simple wizard so that I get professional results without learning the software

features.title: Performance Optimization Suite
features.description: Comprehensive performance improvements including canvas rendering optimization, AI request caching, optimistic UI updates, and background processing for heavy operations.
features.rationale: Canva and Adobe Express users consistently complain about slow performance and lag. A fast, responsive experience is a key differentiator for Nanobanna Pro.
acceptance_criteria: AI generation shows progress within 2 seconds
Previous generations cached for instant replay
UI never freezes during heavy operations
Memory usage under 500MB for typical sessions
user_stories: As a user creating multiple banners, I want instant canvas response so that I can work efficiently
As a user with a lower-end device, I want smooth performance so that I can use the tool without frustration

features.title: Advanced Typography Controls
features.description: Professional typography features including custom font uploads, text effects (shadows, outlines, gradients), variable font size within text boxes, and precise text positioning with numeric input.
features.rationale: Canva users complain about text alignment issues and limited typography control. VistaCreate lacks precise pixel positioning. Professional typography control differentiates from simplified competitors.
acceptance_criteria: Users can upload and use custom fonts
Text effects panel with shadows, outlines, gradients
Variable text sizes in same text box
Numeric X/Y positioning input for precision
user_stories: As a brand manager, I want to use my company's custom font so that my banner matches our brand guidelines exactly
As a designer, I want precise positioning controls so that I can align elements perfectly

features.title: Mobile-Optimized Design Experience
features.description: Full-featured mobile interface with touch-optimized canvas controls, mobile-friendly AI generation, and responsive design across all device sizes. Voice commands become even more valuable on mobile.
features.rationale: Most LinkedIn users access via mobile. Competitors have desktop-first experiences that don't translate well to mobile. A truly mobile-optimized experience addresses this market gap.
acceptance_criteria: Full banner creation possible on mobile
Touch gestures for pan, zoom, select
Voice commands work seamlessly on mobile
Responsive UI adapts to screen size
user_stories: As a mobile user, I want to create banners on my phone so that I can update my LinkedIn while commuting
As a voice-first user, I want to use voice commands on mobile so that I can design hands-free

features.title: Keyboard Shortcuts Enhancement
features.description: Comprehensive keyboard shortcut system with visual overlay, customizable shortcuts, and power-user workflows. Common operations accessible without reaching for the mouse.
features.rationale: Competitor UI redesigns require extra clicks. Keyboard shortcuts enable efficient workflows for power users, addressing frustration with cluttered interfaces requiring multiple clicks.
acceptance_criteria: All major canvas operations have shortcuts
user_stories: As a power user, I want keyboard shortcuts so that I can work faster without using the mouse
As a designer familiar with other tools, I want customizable shortcuts so that I can use my muscle memory

features.title: Direct LinkedIn Publishing
features.description: OAuth integration with LinkedIn to publish banners directly from Nanobanna Pro. Users can update their profile banner, create posts with banner images, and schedule banner updates.
features.rationale: No competitor offers direct LinkedIn integration for banners. Users currently download and manually upload. One-click publishing removes friction and addresses the market gap for LinkedIn-specific tools.
acceptance_criteria: Preview how banner looks on LinkedIn profile
Option to create LinkedIn post with banner
user_stories: As a LinkedIn user, I want to publish my banner directly so that I don't have to download and manually upload
As a job seeker, I want to quickly update my banner so that my profile stays fresh during my search

features.title: Multi-Platform Export Presets
features.description: Pre-configured export presets for all major platforms (LinkedIn banner, YouTube channel art, X/Twitter header, Facebook cover) with automatic resizing and safe zone adjustments per platform.
features.rationale: Users need banners for multiple platforms but each has different dimensions and safe zones. Automatic multi-platform export addresses the pain point of creating content for different dimensions.
acceptance_criteria: One-click export for LinkedIn, YouTube, X/Twitter, Facebook
Batch export all platforms at once
user_stories: As a content creator, I want to export for all my platforms so that I maintain consistent branding everywhere
As a social media manager, I want batch export so that I can update all client profiles efficiently

features.title: Team Brand Profiles
features.description: Shared brand profiles that team members can use to ensure consistency across all designs. Admin can lock certain brand elements while allowing customization of others.
features.rationale: Marketing teams need brand consistency across multiple designers. Competitors don't offer brand enforcement at the team level. This addresses the saturation problem where templates look the same.
acceptance_criteria: Team admin can create shared brand profile
Multiple brand profiles per team (for agencies)
user_stories: As a team admin, I want to share brand guidelines so that all team members create consistent banners
As an agency, I want multiple brand profiles so that I can manage different client brands

features.title: Design Sharing & Feedback
features.description: Share designs with team members or external stakeholders for feedback. Viewers can leave comments on specific areas of the design without needing a Nanobanna account.
features.rationale: Design approval often requires feedback loops. Enabling commenting and sharing streamlines the review process and differentiates from solo-designer tools.
acceptance_criteria: Generate shareable link for any design
Comments pinned to specific design areas
user_stories: As a designer, I want to share designs for approval so that stakeholders can review before publishing
As a manager, I want to leave feedback on specific areas so that the designer knows exactly what to change

features.title: Transparent Usage Dashboard
features.description: User dashboard showing API usage, generation history, and account status. Clear visibility into usage limits, no surprise charges, and easy account management.
features.rationale: Billing transparency issues are the #1 complaint across Canva, Adobe, VistaCreate, and Placeit. Transparent usage tracking directly addresses this widespread pain point.
acceptance_criteria: Clear display of account tier and benefits
user_stories: As a pilot user, I want to see my usage so that I know how much of the shared quota I've used
As a user, I want billing transparency so that I'm never surprised by charges

features.title: Partner Agent System
features.description: Autonomous AI agents (T016-T021) that proactively assist users with banner creation. Agents can suggest improvements, apply brand guidelines automatically, and guide users through complex workflows.
features.rationale: Adobe Express users complain that AI integration hinders workflows. Partner Agents should assist without obstructing, providing suggestions that users can accept or ignore. This is the next evolution of AI-powered design assistance.
acceptance_criteria: Agent respects user preferences and brand guidelines
Agent can execute approved multi-step workflows
Agent learns from user feedback over time
user_stories: As a user, I want AI suggestions while designing so that I can improve my banner without expertise
As a busy professional, I want the agent to handle repetitive tasks so that I can focus on creative decisions

features.title: Design Performance Analytics
features.description: Analytics dashboard showing how designs perform after publishing. Track LinkedIn profile views, engagement metrics, and compare performance across different banner designs (A/B testing results).
features.rationale: Users create banners but have no visibility into their impact. Analytics enable data-driven design decisions and demonstrate the value of banner updates for career growth.
acceptance_criteria: LinkedIn profile view tracking (where API permits)
user_stories: As a job seeker, I want to know if my banner is helping my profile so that I can optimize for more views
As a marketer, I want A/B test results so that I can prove which designs perform better

features.title: Prompt Library & History
features.description: Searchable library of successful AI prompts used in previous generations. Users can save, organize, and reuse prompts that produced good results. Community prompt sharing for Careersy members.
features.rationale: AI prompt crafting is a skill many users lack. A prompt library with proven results helps users get better generations without learning prompt engineering.
acceptance_criteria: All prompts saved with generated results
Search and filter prompts by style/industry
Prompt templates for common use cases
user_stories: As a user who got great results, I want to save my prompt so that I can reuse it later
As a new user, I want to browse successful prompts so that I learn what works

features.title: Scheduled Banner Updates
features.description: Schedule automatic banner updates for specific dates/events (job search launch, conference season, quarterly refresh). Banner variants rotate automatically based on schedule.
features.rationale: Dynamic banner content drives 30% more engagement according to market research. Scheduled updates enable users to maintain fresh profiles without manual intervention.
acceptance_criteria: Schedule banner changes for future dates
user_stories: As a conference speaker, I want my banner to update automatically during events so that I promote my sessions
As a job seeker, I want to schedule a fresh banner weekly so that my profile stays active

features.title: Animated Banner Support
features.description: Create animated/motion banners for LinkedIn video backgrounds and other platforms that support motion. Simple animations like parallax effects, subtle movements, and looping sequences.
features.rationale: Static banners are table stakes. Animated content stands out in feeds and captures attention. This is a future differentiator as platforms increasingly support motion content.
acceptance_criteria: Export as video and GIF formats
user_stories: As a content creator, I want animated banners so that my profile stands out from static banners
As a video creator, I want motion graphics so that my banner matches my content style

features.title: Real-Time Collaboration
features.description: Multiple users can edit the same design simultaneously with live cursors, real-time sync, and presence indicators. Built for agency teams and collaborative brand work.
features.rationale: Adobe and Figma offer collaboration but not for specialized banner creation. Real-time collaboration enables teams to work together efficiently on brand assets.
user_stories: As an agency team, I want to collaborate in real-time so that we can work on client banners together
As a remote team, I want live collaboration so that we can brainstorm designs during calls

features.title: Enterprise SSO & Admin Controls
features.description: SAML/OIDC single sign-on for enterprise teams, admin dashboard for user management, and compliance features for regulated industries.
features.rationale: Enterprise customers require SSO and admin controls for security and compliance. This opens up B2B revenue opportunities beyond individual users.
user_stories: As an IT admin, I want SSO so that employees can access with corporate credentials
As a compliance officer, I want audit logs so that we can meet regulatory requirements

features.title: API for External Integrations
features.description: Public API for third-party integrations, enabling banner generation from external tools like Zapier, Make, and custom applications.
features.rationale: BannerBear serves the API market but requires technical skills. A simpler API with pre-built integrations enables automation without coding expertise.
user_stories: As a developer, I want an API so that I can integrate banner generation into my workflows
As a marketer, I want Zapier integration so that I can automate banner creation without coding
